name: midkernel
description: Scan a GitHub repository from your agent. Midkernel Scan runs an open workflow in an isolated sandbox and returns a report with the complete log. Credits meter the run.

MIDKERNEL_APP_URL.title: Midkernel app URL
MIDKERNEL_APP_URL.description: Base URL for Scan APIs, including Next basePath in production (https://midkernel.com/app). Local: http://localhost:3000 or http://localhost:3000/app.

MIDKERNEL_API_TOKEN.title: Midkernel API token
MIDKERNEL_API_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for stdio until Midkernel OAuth completes. Placeholder values are ignored. Credits meter hosted runs; Stripe is not implemented here.

MIDKERNEL_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.title: Midkernel OAuth client id
MIDKERNEL_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Static Cursor remote MCP client id. Midkernel is the AS (not Google). Placeholder until the app hosts authorize/token.

GITHUB_APP_ID.title: GitHub App ID
GITHUB_APP_ID.description: Read-only GitHub App. IT owns OAuth and scopes. Listing uses session tokens; App credentials stay on midkernel/app.

GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.title: GitHub App private key
GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Placeholder. Do not commit a real key. Not required for the plugin HTTP client.
